Vue Test Utils interaction test.description:
Complete component interaction test. Every trigger is awaited because Vue applies DOM updates on the next tick. Requires vitest, @vue/test-utils and a DOM environment.

完整的组件交互测试；每次 trigger 都要 await，因为 Vue 在下一个 tick 才应用 DOM 更新；需要 vitest、@vue/test-utils 与 DOM 测试环境。

Vue Test Utils emitted events.description:
Assert the events a component emitted and the payloads it sent. Requires a wrapper from mount.

断言组件发出的事件及其载荷；需要 mount 返回的 wrapper。

Testing Library user interaction test.description:
Complete test driven through the accessibility tree rather than internal state. Requires vitest, @testing-library/vue, @testing-library/user-event, a jest-dom setup and a DOM environment.

完整的测试，经由无障碍树而非内部状态驱动；需要 vitest、@testing-library/vue、@testing-library/user-event、jest-dom setup 与 DOM 测试环境。

Composable unit test.description:
Test a composable without mounting a component; the scope gives it a place for its effects and cleanup to run. A composable that calls lifecycle hooks needs a component instead. Requires vitest and vue.

不挂载组件即可测试组合式函数，effectScope 为其副作用与清理提供归属；调用了生命周期钩子的组合式函数仍需真实组件；需要 vitest 与 vue。

Query test wrapper.description:
Give each test its own query client, so retries and a shared cache do not leak between cases. Requires QueryClient and VueQueryPlugin from @tanstack/vue-query and mount from @vue/test-utils.

为每个用例配置独立的 query client，避免重试与共享缓存在用例之间串味；需要 @tanstack/vue-query 的 QueryClient 与 VueQueryPlugin，以及 @vue/test-utils 的 mount。

Async UI assertion.description:
Let pending promises settle before asserting on what rendered. Requires flushPromises from @vue/test-utils.

在断言渲染结果前先让挂起的 promise 结算；需要 @vue/test-utils 的 flushPromises。
